512-3043-7014.easyPrerequisites: Axebane Guardian and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
512-3043-7014.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
512-3043-7014.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Axebane Guardian, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-3043-7014.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Axebane Guardian's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

2034-4145-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Millicent, adding {C}{C}.
When Millicent dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Millicent trigger, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Millicent from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

339-677-1753-6495.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1999-4613-7340-7826.easyPrerequisites:
Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least X Foods.
1999-4613-7340-7826.description:
Activate Bag End Banquet by tapping it, adding at least two mana which you can spend to activate Master Transmuter due to Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Bag End Banquet from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sewer-veillance Cam from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand, putting Bag End Banquet from your hand onto the vattlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Repeat.

348-1152-2992-4976-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-2992-4976-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Living Lightning and any creature not part of the combo.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Open the Graves triggers.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

3179-3188-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Social Climber trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-3188-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2908-3682-5542-7646.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying one mana.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Dream Stalker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

880-4871-7201.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4871-7201.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

985-3459-4289-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1268-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 4 or greater.
1268-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.

141-5147-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5147-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

2584-5641-6919.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
2584-5641-6919.notablePrerequisites: You control a static effect that boosts the power of creatures and/or creature tokens you control by at least 1.
2584-5641-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Basking Broodscale.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Pandemonium triggers, dealing damage to Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

4029-4968-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Benevolent Hydra.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
4029-4968-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

1456-1987-4423-6893.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and The Eternity Elevator by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and The Eternity Elevator.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

4050-5220-6766.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using one colored mana or less.
4050-5220-6766.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

654-5531-6620-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
654-5531-6620-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1283-4565.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1283-4565.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

997-1940-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-1940-6249--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

372-2072-3277.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Scrollshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2072-3277.description:
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Scrollshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

4826-5226-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Archelos is untapped.
4826-5226-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Lithatog's second ability by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

1339-1636-2711.notablePrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
1339-1636-2711.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, causing you to reveal the top card of your library, then causing you to add {G} and gain 1 life for each nonland card revealed this way, then causing each player to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2429-3193-4772.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Olivia deathtouch.
2429-3193-4772.description:
Give Olivia deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Olivia's first ability by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, destroying it due to Olivia's deathtouch, and putting two +1/+1 counters on Olivia.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have a way to give Olivia deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2493-4050-4053-4323.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken creature with base toughness two or greater.
2493-4050-4053-4323.description:
Cast Cauldron Haze by paying {1}{W/B}, giving Archaeoamncer and at least one additional creature with base toughness two or greater persist until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Archaeomancer and the additional creature, adding  {1}{W/B}.
When the creatures die, their persisit abilities trigger, returning themselves from your graveyard to the battlefield with zero -1/-1 counters due to Solemnity.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cauldron Haze to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
If you control an additional nontoken creature with base toughness two or greater, you may also sacrifice and return it to get infinite colored mana.

2222-3858-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Auriok Bladewarden has power 1 or greater.
Freed from the Real attached to Auriok Bladewarden.
2222-3858-4222.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Auriok Bladewarden by tapping it, giving itself +X/+X until end of turn, where X is its power.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Auriok Bladewarden.
Repeat from step 2 until Auriok Bladewarden has power nineteen or greater, omitting step 3 on the final iteration.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger from step 1, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

1563-3228-4231-4321.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token as well as a Food, a Clue and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Food and Clue by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
